title: An Auction, Conveniently

lines.speaker: margo
lines.en: A 'Vane estate studies' sale, announced the very month the case runs hot. Timing like that is a message. Someone is liquidating.

lines.speaker: casal
lines.en: Preview passes, with my compliments. Do give the consignor my regards. All of them.

caseLine: The Vane estate-studies auction is announced. Margo smells liquidation.

title: The Map Doesn't Match

lines.speaker: narration
lines.en: Lot 9 against the catalog photograph: the 1904 study has no North Mole. The museum's '1904' painting does. The Mole was built in 1921.

lines.speaker: margo
lines.en: The brooch. {gran} had one polished lie like that: wear a bird, sing nothing.

caseLine: Lot 9, 1904 study: no North Mole on the map. The museum's painting has one.

title: Grief With a Timetable

lines.speaker: margo
lines.en: Estate sales are grief with a catalog. This one's grief with a timetable.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.en: The consignor is liquidating everything for bearer bonds, collect by month's end. Someone is packing a life into a suitcase.

caseLine: Aurelia Trust is liquidating everything for bearer bonds. Month's end.

peopleFacts.fact: Consignor of Vane material for years — Aurelia Trust.

title: Adele's Confession

lines.speaker: adele
lines.en: I found the anomaly two years ago. I buried it, and booked Lorentz to dig it back up when I was brave enough. That was the examination.

lines.speaker: adele
lines.en: Ottilie Marsh taught me everything. Then the board needed a name, and I let them spend hers.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.en: Guilty people don't schedule their own exposure. Herring number one, resolved — at the price of watching her pay it.

caseLine: Adele scheduled her own exposure. Cleared — and estranged from her teacher since 1921.

peopleFacts.fact: Buried the anomaly, then booked the exam that would expose it.
Taught Adele. Dismissed 1921 when 'the board needed a name.'

title: Tea With Ottilie Marsh

lines.speaker: ottilie
lines.en: I haven't set foot in the Belmont since 1921. Whoever hung that frame level should be consulted, not hunted.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.en: A widow's flat, precise as a museum case. She pours exactly, corrects your grip on the cup out of professional habit, and denies nothing that's true.

lines.speaker: margo
lines.en: An orchid on her sill. Conservatory stock. She never named the glasshouse; her windowsill did.

caseLine: Tea with Ottilie Marsh. The season's finest non-lie, and an orchid-shaped question.

peopleFacts.fact: 'I haven't set foot in the Belmont since 1921.' True. Until Sunday.

title: Two People

lines.speaker: margo
lines.en: Wire from my auction contact: the Trust's courier moved papers this hour. And Sarto has not left the glasshouse all day.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.en: The Broker and the painter are two people. The wrong theory dies with witnesses present.

caseLine: The Broker and the painter are two people. The Vane theory dies honestly.

peopleFacts.fact: Alive, gentle, and demonstrably not the Broker.

title: Casal's Midnight Summons

lines.speaker: casal
lines.en: They stole from me, detective. There are rules.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.en: Intruders took exactly one thing: the 1926 sale file. But Casal is Casal — the duplicate is in the floor safe, and outrage has made him generous.

caseLine: The Broker is erasing the fraud's paper spine. Casal kept a duplicate.

peopleFacts.fact: Burgled of exactly one file; hands over the duplicate himself.

flavorChoice.dry: There are laws, too. You should try one.
flavorChoice.warm: Then let's make them regret the exception.

title: The Chart Rooms

lines.speaker: margo
lines.en: If she grew up here… Halloway, the painting grew up here.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.en: Her father's chart rooms, lease unbroken since 1911. The room is half-packed: a life mid-departure. Halloway feeds the pigeons before working. Standards.

lines.speaker: margo
lines.en: She didn't steal a painting. She's been guarding one. There's a difference — ask any grandmother.

caseLine: The original lived in the clocktower since 1904. Fresh tack holes. The Selene, Pier 4, Sunday.

peopleFacts.fact: Nachtigall. Person of interest. Moving the original — Sunday, the Selene.
